only_variable: explicit immutable observation/rig/noise snapshots and stale-info rejection; no model or risk-policy changes
inputs: typed Observation; actual camera K/D/R/T/size/roles; noise precision/source/calibrated/camera binding; prior frozen candidate cache
counterexamples: same frame/time with altered pixel, confidence, masks, geometric rays, clock provenance, noise precision/calibration status or camera matrix; preserve pre-fix acceptance record
success: unchanged and exact value dtype/device copy accepted
changed input causes explicit A4 fallback with retained reason
reweight allows deliberate new precision at unchanged observation and original frozen rig, creates fresh noise binding; old snapshot remains unchanged
new candidate caches bind their exact observation, legacy caches remain explicitly unverified
JSON serialization excludes NaN from ignored slots and snapshots do not alias mutable input tensors
fixture_boundary: unbound analytic information allowed only when both noise_source and observation.source explicitly analytic; no production bypass based on noise label alone
stop: fix verified counterexamples only; no data/model training and no claim accuracy improvement
limitations: snapshot verifies supplied numerical inputs, not independent truth or licensed body asset identity; caller retains source/decoder protocol duties
